summary: Tested the purchase section in the 'Krijo Artikull' form end to end: backend pytest (15 tests including the iteration_2 barcode regression, 14 passed) and Playwright as admin. Everything requested works. The purchase section shows on create and not on edit. Supplier flow: cost 10 x qty 5 shows a total of € 50.00 with paid prefilled to 50.00; changing paid to 20 shows 'Borxh: € 30.00'; after saving, stock is 5, Blerjet lists the supplier with 50/20/30, and the supplier balance went up by 30. Citizen flow: a phone with 1 IMEI and cost 100 is saved with qty 1; Blerjet shows 'Name (qytetar · PN)'; GET /api/citizens returns the citizen without _id; typing the same name again fills in the phone and personal no; the same personal no updates the existing citizen instead of making a duplicate. A citizen with no name shows the toast 'Shkruaj emrin e qytetarit nga i cili e bleve' and nothing is saved. Quantity 0 or no purchase field creates no purchase. Paid above the total is capped at the total. A phone with a typed quantity and no IMEI keeps that quantity. Employee gets 403 on POST /products and GET /citizens. Regression on /sale/new: barcode 123456789099 + Enter fills row 0; '+ Krijo artikull të ri' opens the dialog with the purchase section, Gjenero makes a 13-digit EAN, and after saving the new product is selected in row 1 with row 0 unchanged.

minor.issue: An invalid purchase.supplier_id (e.g. 'not-an-objectid') returns 500. The product and the purchase are already saved before ObjectId() fails in the supplier balance update, so the data is left half-written. Only reachable through the API; the UI always sends a valid id.
seller_type=supplier with no supplier picked ('— Pa furnitor —') and paid < total saves a purchase with a due amount, but the debt is not tracked on any supplier.

issues: Subtitle still says 'Hyrja e produkteve nga furnitorët' even though citizen purchases now appear there (minor)

action_items: In create_product/_record_product_purchase, check purchase.supplier_id (valid ObjectId that exists) before inserting the product; return 400/404
Optional: when seller_type=supplier and paid < total, require a supplier
critical_code_review_comments: create_product is not atomic: product insert, citizen upsert, purchase insert and supplier $inc are separate writes, so a failure partway leaves partial data
Deleting a product does not touch the purchase that was auto-created for it or the supplier debt from it
pickCitizen auto-fills by name only (first match); two citizens with the same name but different personal numbers cannot be told apart in the datalist
server.py is 1220+ lines; should be split into routers

success_rate.backend: 93% (14/15; the 1 failure is the invalid supplier_id edge case)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_PP_*/TEST_UI_* products, suppliers and citizens plus their purchases; all deleted afterwards. Only test suppliers were used, so no real supplier balances changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_product_purchase.py cleans up after itself via MongoDB (it reads /app/backend/.env). The UI flow uses supplier 'TEST_UI_Supplier'; create it through the API before running. Selectors: product-purchase-section, product-seller-type-select, product-supplier-select, product-citizen-*-input, product-purchase-total, product-purchase-paid-input.
